members.name: v_a
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which of these describes the customer's specific issue or question best?

criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: There is an unknown charge, card payment or purchase on my account that I don't recognise or didn't make, or how to dispute or cancel a card or debit card transaction
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: There is a cash/ATM withdrawal on my account that I didn't make
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: A direct debit: one I don't recognise or didn't set up, or I want to dispute, cancel or get a refund for a direct debit
criteria.compromised_card: I think my card or account has been compromised, hacked or used by someone else
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: My card was lost or stolen and I need to report or freeze it
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: My phone (with the app) was lost, stolen, left behind or misplaced, or everything was stolen so I can't use the app
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept / swallowed / took my card, or I lost access to my card while withdrawing cash
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot my app passcode or password, need to reset it, or can't log in with it
criteria.change_pin: How or where to change my card PIN
criteria.pin_blocked: My PIN is blocked, or I entered the wrong PIN too many times, or I forgot my PIN
criteria.unknown_money_in: Money appeared in my account that I didn't put there
criteria.request_refund: I want a refund for something I bought or returned, or a problem with a merchant order
criteria.refund_not_showing_up: A merchant refund I was promised hasn't appeared in my account
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: I was charged twice / a duplicate charge for the same payment
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The ATM gave me less cash than I requested, a different amount, or I haven't received the cash I withdrew
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment was cancelled, terminated, reversed or reverted, or the money came back
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: There's an unexplained extra small charge or fee on my statement that I can't account for
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: The exchange rate applied to a card purchase abroad / in foreign currency was wrong or too high
criteria.cash_withdrawal_exchange_rate: Getting cash from ATMs abroad or in a foreign currency: the exchange rate, fees or charges for it (general questions or complaints that it was wrong or too high)
criteria.exchange_charge_complaint: Complaint about a currency exchange I already made: it cost me too much, or the charges on it aren't right
criteria.activate_my_card: How to activate my new card
criteria.card_arrival: My new card hasn't arrived yet / where is my card
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, delivery dates, tracking or delivery to a country
criteria.card_linking: Adding, linking or making my card show up in the app; reactivating a card I found after reporting it lost
criteria.card_not_working: My card isn't working / has stopped working (not a specific decline)
criteria.card_about_to_expire: My card is about to expire / expired, how to renew or replace it
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional, second or spare physical card
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a (new or replacement) physical card, including cost of a replacement
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get, order or access a virtual card
criteria.disposable_virtual_card: Disposable virtual cards: how to get one, how many, how many times they can be used
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: My virtual or disposable card is not working or was rejected
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Which kinds of cards you offer or carry; Visa vs Mastercard: whether you offer or accept Visa or Mastercard, whether my card is one or the other, or asking for one of them
criteria.declined_card_payment: My card payment was declined at a shop, restaurant or online
criteria.pending_card_payment: A payment or purchase I made is still pending, taking long, or hasn't gone through yet
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash/ATM withdrawal is still pending, or my balance doesn't yet reflect cash I withdrew
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: The ATM refused or declined my card when I tried to withdraw cash
criteria.card_fees: What a card costs: fees for getting, ordering, replacing or holding a card
criteria.get_physical_card_pin: Where to find my PIN, I don't have a PIN, or a general question about my card's PIN (not changing or unblocking it)
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Anything about Apple Pay, Google Pay or Apple Watch: using them, topping up through them (including which cards or currencies they accept), or when they fail
criteria.card_acceptance: Where my card is accepted / can I use my card at a particular place or merchant
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs I can use my card at
criteria.transfer_timing: How long a bank transfer takes to arrive
criteria.pending_transfer: My bank transfer is still pending / not completed yet
criteria.failed_transfer: My transfer failed / why would a transfer fail
criteria.cancel_transfer: I want to cancel or reverse a transfer I made, or I sent money to the wrong account
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: The person I sent money to hasn't received it
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into my account from another bank account or card
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money / get paid into my account, or SWIFT/international transfers
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_transfer: My balance didn't update after a bank transfer
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_deposit: My balance didn't update after a cash or cheque deposit
criteria.top_up_failed: My top-up failed or didn't work (other than through Apple Pay / Google Pay)
criteria.top_up_reverted: My top-up was reverted or the topped-up money disappeared
criteria.pending_top_up: My top-up is still pending / not showing
criteria.how_to_top_up: How to top up my account, including by card, bank transfer, cash or cheque, and where
criteria.exchange_rate: General question about what exchange rates you use, how they are set or what the current rate is (not a complaint that the rate applied to my transaction was wrong)
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currency in the app
criteria.exchange_fee_question: General question about whether there is a fee or extra cost for exchanging currency and how much it is
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which currencies I can hold and exchange
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (Visa, American Express, credit card, other cards, cards from another country such as a US card) or currencies I can use to top up, add funds or pay in (not via Apple Pay / Google Pay, and not Visa vs Mastercard)
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: I was charged a fee for a card payment
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: I was charged a fee for an ATM/cash withdrawal, or are ATM withdrawals free (not abroad / foreign currency)
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: I was charged a fee for a transfer, or transfer fees
criteria.top_up_fee: Fees for topping up (by card, bank transfer, cash)
criteria.verify_my_identity: What I need / how to verify my identity
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why I need to verify my identity
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification isn't working / the app can't recognise me
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Proving or explaining source of funds, or where money in my account came from / who is sending me money
criteria.verify_top_up: Top-up verification code, or how to verify my top-up card
criteria.age_limit: Age requirements to open an account
criteria.country_support: Which countries you operate in or support, or whether I can sign up or get a card when living in a particular country
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: A transfer or purchase is not allowed, blocked or 'not possible' (e.g. to a particular beneficiary or a crypto exchange)
